pr_title: Store horizontal and vertical split offsets separately in FileSystem dock

issue_context.title: FileSystem dock should remember it's split offset between runs
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v4.2.beta.custom_build [a574c0296]

### System information

linux

### Issue description

- The FileSystem split offset is not restored between restarts
- You can now split the FileSystem dock in horizontal mode in 4.2.
- The default split offset is unusable in horizontal mode
- It's important to remember the split offset value, because I set mine to match a certain number of item columns (otherwise there's an ugly blank space on the right). Having to set it up manually again (it's a pixel perfect setting and I really want it set in the right place) is a pain. But it's a minor pain for everyone, regardless of precision.
- It can be fixed with an addon, but it really should behave correctly by default (and even be saved in editor layouts maybe)

|before setting the offset|after setting the offset|after restarting the editor|
|-|-|-|
|![Screenshot from 2023-10-14 15-50-35](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/71937306/fb6dada3-4a3c-4790-9d12-5c3ba77aac55)|![Screenshot from 2023-10-14 15-50-39](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/71937306/717de8bc-0d92-4849-8b04-3a1244047e31)|![Screenshot from 2023-10-14 15-50-46](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/71937306/6d6c1ea2-0aa6-4e4a-8385-f6da3627596f)|






### Steps to reproduce

- set the split offset of the FileSystem
- restart the editor
- notice how the split is back to default
- try again with the FileSystem in horizontal mode, and notice that the default value is unusable

### Minimal reproduction project

any
